messages:
Priya: Kickoff for new retailer pilot. Need to pick 3 focused flows, define acceptance criteria, and a 4-week rollout. Also list procurementsecurity asks.
Luke (AE): They want revenue impact ASAP. My recommendation: 1) Checkout suggestions, 2) Search relevance, 3) Cart recovery.
Marta (RetailOps): Confirmed those. Checkout and search must be in MVP. Recovery can be a follow-on if time box hits.
Priya: Minimal endpoints to prototype: POST /v1/generate/checkout-hints, POST /v1/embeddings/search, POST /v1/rerank/recs.
Luke (AE): Dev effort estimates: generate+embeddings 1-2 days each, rerank 3 days for low-latency path.
Priya: Suggested success metrics:
- Checkout: +3% conversion or -15% checkout help tickets
- Search: NDCG@10 >= +10% and SKU exact match >= 95%
- Cart recovery: +4% recovery in pilot cohort
DevBot: Perf targets: generate p95 <300ms, embeddings p95 <150ms, rerank p95 <250ms.
Priya: Eval plan: 150 labeled prompts per flow, 10% holdout, 40 human checks each, pass if combined >=80%.
sec-bot: Procurement will ask: EU data residency? SAML SSO? KMS? Retention policy? SOC2 evidence?
Marta (RetailOps): They require EU residency and SAML SSO. I'll confirm PII scope tomorrow.
Luke (AE): Pricing note: offer pilot 30% off hosted rates; conversion path to Dedicated with reserved credits. Need draft by Friday.
Priya: Action items this week: 1) pilot quote draft, 2) security answers stub, 3) integration checklist + sample data spec. Check-in Thu 9am PT.
